user.title: Connect to Vacuula
user.description: Address of your Vacuula server. When Vacuula runs as a Home Assistant app the default works; otherwise use the IP address of the machine running Vacuula (port 80 by default).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Vacuula server at this address.

abort.already_configured: This Vacuula server is already configured.

clean_zones.name: Clean zones
clean_zones.description: Clean one or more named zones of the active map.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone names (or ids), as drawn in the Vacuula app.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map name or id. Defaults to the active map on the robot.

mode.name: Cleaning mode
mode.description: Overrides the cleaning mode select for this run.

navigation_mode.name: Navigation mode
navigation_mode.description: Overrides the navigation mode select for this run.

nogo_enabled.name: Respect no-go lines
nogo_enabled.description: Avoid the no-go lines and zones of the map.

get_zones.name: Get zones
get_zones.description: Return the maps with their cleaning zones and no-go lines.
